correctness.rationale: For r>=2 and positive petal sizes, every maximal geodesic is an in-petal edge or a cross-petal hub triple. This gives the exact face complex K ∪ (c*D(X)), K the join of discrete petal complexes, and N separate attachment points. The homotopy cofiber is K wedge (N-1) circles, yielding the stated integral S^{r-1} wedge with multiplicity product(m_i-1), including singleton-petal and r=2 boundary cases. Direct facet complements give F(z)=product(1+m_i z)+z+Nz² and M(z)=product(m_i)z^{N+1-r}+Nz^{N-1}. Independent BFS full-shortest-path computations checked five profiles, not all r.
